about_the_game:
🕯️ Mannequin Syndrome

They were never meant to move.

After an experimental AI project went horribly wrong, the world changed forever. What began as a harmless upgrade for retail mannequins became a full-scale anomaly. Now the mannequins think, move, and hunt.

Mannequin Syndrome is a 1–4 player co-op psychological horror game focused on atmosphere, investigation, and survival. You and your team are investigators sent to isolated, overrun locations. Your mission: uncover the truth, complete critical objectives, and stop the corrupted AI presence before it's too late.

🔦 Core Experience

• Solo or Co-Op (1–4 Players) – Survive alone or with friends
• Simple Yet Tense Gameplay – Search, interact, solve, and stay alive
• Evolving Objectives – Each level offers unique tasks and challenges
• Unpredictable Mannequin AI – They see, listen, and react
• Environmental Storytelling – Discover the past through scattered clues and notes
• Ritual-Based Endings – Complete site-specific actions to purge corruption
• Standalone Chapters – No story commitment—jump into any map

📦 Planned Expansions

Future updates will introduce:
• New Maps & Locations
• More Mannequin Variants
• Enhanced Mechanics & Gameplay Layers
• Dynamic Events & Traps
• Expanded Lore & Replayability

The mannequins don’t just stand still anymore...
Will you survive the Syndrome?
